title: caryophyllata reptans
intro: Caryophyllata reptans, commonly known as Winter Savory, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family Lamiaceae. It is valued for its health benefits, which include aiding digestion, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Winter Savory include its ability to relax the muscles, reduce stress, and act as a carminative, relieving flatulence and indigestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include carvacrol, thymol, and borneol, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its aromatic and antibacterial effects.
